historical_mapping: Retrospective proxy: successful delivery with reported_anomalies=0 -> clean_report; successful delivery with reported_anomalies>0 -> anomaly_report. Not a retrospective application of the T+14 evidence protocol. Different configurations and observation conditions limit comparability.
smoothing: historical_add_one uses (count+1)/(4+4), equivalent to a symmetric Dirichlet(1,1,1,1) posterior predictive under a multinomial model. This is an assumption, not an empirical frequency.
evaluation: Use the identical primary Y coding and validity/disposition rules. VOID_CONFIGURATION and NOT_LAUNCHED receive no scores. Report all comparators; do not select a baseline after observing the outcome.
zero_probability_policy: Infinite log loss is represented by null with zero_probability_observed=true, never clipped.
